_readme: Header CONSTRUCT -> UnysonPlus Theme Settings capability map.
This is the knowledge base that stops an agent re-deriving the theme's header surface by
grepping ~2,300 lines of option PHP every time it audits a source site. Each construct that
survey.mjs can detect is mapped to the option that reproduces it, the file that defines that
EXACT  a settings field reproduces the source value as-is.
NEAR   the option exists but its value is fixed or quantised (a boolean, or a 3-value
preset) so the result is visually close but not identical.
CSS    no option covers it - needs a custom declaration.
Some constructs refine their verdict from the measured value (e.g. a glass blur of 10px is
EXACT, 40px is NEAR). That conditional lives in digest.mjs and is described here as
'exact_when'. Everything else - option ids, file paths, gaps - lives here.
MAINTENANCE: when a header option is added or changed in unysonplus-theme, update the matching
entry and bump 'version'. 'verified_against' records when the map was last checked against the
v1.1.0 adds the FOOTER constructs (footer_*). The footer's row+column model is more flexible than the header's fixed L/C/R: up to 6 columns at ANY ratio via a split-slider, across four stacked rows.

v1.2.0 - G1-G7 are CLOSED (unysonplus-theme 2.5.90): scrolled height, glass blur, header top offset, shadow depth, numeric radius/inset, scrolled link colour, hover fade and an inline theme-toggle element all exist now. Only G8 (bottom-dock chrome) remains open, and it needs no action. The gaps[] entries are kept with a status for provenance.

v1.3.0 - the footer's first real gaps (F1-F4) were found by DEEPENING the probe: the original footer pass scored 100% EXACT only because it measured 14 coarse constructs and never touched link hover, column gap or mobile stacking. All four are CLOSED in theme 2.5.92. Lesson: a 100% score is a claim about the measurement as much as the subject.

position.note: static | sticky | overlay (transparent over the first section, then pins)

hide_on_scroll.note: slide up on scroll down, reveal on scroll up (sticky/overlay only)

gradient_bg.note: background-pro - colour + gradient + image, video disabled

glass_blur.note: blur radius and saturation are both options now (empty/140% = the historic blur(10px) saturate(1.4))
glass_blur.exact_when: the source filter is blur (+saturate) only - an extra contrast()/brightness() is still NEAR

bottom_border.note: width + style + colour per side; header_border is the quick hairline toggle

shadow.note: toggle plus a soft/medium/strong depth select driving --header-shadow

container_width.note: fixed vs fluid; container_width is the CONTENT width (gutter sits outside)

slot_layout.exact_when: the source bar has 3 or fewer visible slots
slot_layout.note: addable-popup columns, drag between columns via connect_group

centred_nav.note: put the menu in the centre column; logo left, CTA right

logo.note: image (plus retina / sticky / mobile / transparent variants) or a text wordmark + tagline + icon

cta_button.note: style presets sourced from General > Buttons; text, link, size

dropdown_submenu.note: 5 panel designs; Mega Menu tab when that extension is active

cart.note: registered by the WooCommerce extension via the unysonplus_hf_elements filter (wishlist too)

topbar.note: renders only when a column has an element; own custom-styling block

theme_toggle.note: inline header/footer element; suppresses the floating corner button so there is only one control

hover_opacity.note: no opacity-fade preset; nearest is none + a hover colour

scrolled_height.note: numeric Scrolled Header Height driving --header-height-stuck; empty = the at-rest height

floating_radius.note: numeric override wins when filled; resolved in inc/includes/layout.php beside the presets

floating_top_offset.note: drives --header-design-offset; empty = the design default (.75rem pill / 1rem card)

overlay_fullscreen.note: panel / radial / concentric styles + colour mode + background

bottom_dock.note: no bottom-anchored chrome mode; reachable with a Snippet element + position:fixed

hamburger_drawer.note: toggle style/size/colour, drawer side/width/radius/colours/alignment, open animation, scrim colour/opacity/blur, close-on-click, swipe-to-close, submenu behaviour

no_mobile_nav_in_source.note: SOURCE DEFECT, not a fidelity target - the source hides its links with no drawer; the theme supplies one, so the rebuild improves on the original. Counted as non-defect by default; --strict-mobile counts it as a miss.

footer_rows.option: Pre-Footer / Main Footer / Post-Footer / Copyright rows
footer_rows.exact_when: the source footer has 4 or fewer stacked bands
footer_rows.note: each row renders only when a column has content. Measured max in 36 sampled footers: 4 rows - the model is sufficient.

footer_columns.note: count + widths + names in ONE split-slider control. Max is the 2nd arg of unysonplus_footer_columns_field() and the theme passes 8 (NOT the 6 the footer-main.php docblock claims).

footer_column_ratio.note: ANY ratio, not a preset list - a wide brand column beside narrow link columns is exact. For 2-6 columns there is also an Auto Width (fit-to-content) flex mode that bypasses the ratio entirely, which is the case a 12-column grid cannot express.

footer_border_top.note: extent can be full, container, or a custom width

footer_padding.note: the selects are constrained to the site Spacing Scale (ceiling 8rem); the numeric overrides win when filled. Before they existed, 5% of measured paddings clamped at the ceiling, losing up to 112px.

footer_logo.note: separate upload from the header logo

footer_newsletter.note: heading, description, placeholder, button, success message, list id

footer_link_hover.note: drives --footer-link-hover (+ --footer-link-hover-opacity:1 so the legacy .85 fade does not dim it). 90% of sampled footers change link colour on hover.

footer_col_gap.note: drives --footer-col-gap for all three row modes. 80% of measured footers differ from the theme default; 48px is the most common.

footer_mobile_columns.note: 1 (stacked, the historic behaviour) or 2 below 768px. 11% of footers keep 2-up on a phone.

gaps.title: On-scroll geometry is a boolean, not a value
gaps.fix: add a 'Scrolled Header Height' unit-input beside sticky_shrink_height driving --header-height-stuck; fall back to the current .25rem when empty

gaps.title: Glass blur radius is globally fixed at 10px
gaps.fix: expose a 'Glass Blur' unit-input writing --glass-blur (the pill and card partials already read the variable); optionally a saturation slider

gaps.title: No top offset for a detached header
gaps.fix: add a 'Header Offset (Top)' unit-input to the pill and card reveals driving --header-design-offset, mirroring the existing --header-design-inset
gaps.status: THEME-SIDE ONLY in unysonplus-theme 2.5.90 — the options exist (pill_offset/card_offset/pill_radius_custom/card_radius_custom/pill_inset_custom) but NEITHER converter twin emits them, so no conversion can reach them. NOT pursued: measured 2/173 corpus sites (1.2%) are detached pill/card headers, and both samples had a zero-width rect, so even that is shaky. The earlier '9 headers' figure does not reproduce. Verify with tools/option-reachability/check.mjs.

gaps.title: Shadow is a boolean with one fixed value
gaps.fix: a soft/medium/strong select (the pattern pill_shadow and card_shadow already use) or a control writing --header-shadow

gaps.title: Floating bar radius and side inset are 3-value presets
gaps.fix: allow a numeric override alongside the preset (the house pattern: preset select + optional unit-input that wins when filled)

gaps.title: Two small menu-state gaps
gaps.fix: add a 'Fade' preset to menu_item_style, and a scroll_link_color field to the On Scroll group (the latter is required by any dark-text-on-scroll design)

gaps.title: Dark-mode toggle is not a header element
gaps.fix: register a theme_toggle element in the header element popup, reusing the existing dark-mode script

gaps.title: No bottom-dock chrome archetype
gaps.fix: not worth a mode on current evidence - reachable today with a Snippet element plus position:fixed CSS. Revisit if it recurs.

gaps.title: Footer padding was a spacing-scale select with a ceiling
No footer column gap option (theme hard-coded 40/32/28px)
gaps.fix: added footer_col_gap driving --footer-col-gap in all three row modes

gaps.title: No footer link HOVER colour (only a fixed .85 fade)
